title: robot
summary: A word that escaped from a theatre and travelled the world.
question: Where was the word robot invented?
completion: English borrowed robot from Czech. The 1920 play R.U.R. used a name suggested by Josef Čapek, from robota. German later borrowed its machine word from English.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
